status_codes.resolved: edit content known from code current at the run and consistent with the fitted design columns (and with the input copy where retained)
status_codes.assumed: edit content taken from the closest committed code or another source; stated with its check
status_codes.none: no producer edit to events (preproc_events false, or the function returns unchanged events)
